verdict.rationale: Read-pixel blocking and data transparency are fair questions for an email client, so the axis applies. The pack contains no first-party documentation of default tracking-pixel blocking or a data-handling disclosure. Community comments instead say users cannot turn off images and that all mail is stored on Superhuman's servers. Because there is no vendor claim for this to contradict, the verdict is none rather than disputed.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
